Indian fashion trends focus on lightweight and comfortable styles

Indian fashion is seeing a trend towards lightweight and comfortable clothing and accessories, particularly for daily wear and festive occasions. This shift emphasizes practicality alongside style, with a focus on materials and designs that offer ease and luxury. The trend caters to modern lifestyles and the desire for comfortable yet fashionable choices.
